patterns.name: What is underneath
patterns.stands_for: Something is presented as the story; look underneath and a different thing is driving it; name that thing.

patterns.name: The expert's catch
patterns.stands_for: A piece of work exists; someone who knows the field looks at it; it holds, breaks, or looks fine but is not.

patterns.name: What surrounds the tool
patterns.stands_for: Two tools or models get compared; look at what surrounds each; the surroundings, not the brains inside, make the difference.

patterns.name: Same shape, other field
patterns.stands_for: A pattern seen in one field shows the same shape in another; the pattern is the finding, the fields are just examples.

patterns.name: Checked by using it
patterns.stands_for: A helper shows it understood by applying it; the person feels where it is off; the correction sharpens the helper; the cycle repeats.
patterns.note: Kept at this rank by a floor rule: the domain count is below the bar, and ranks are not computed downward.

patterns.name: A no that sets a rule
patterns.stands_for: A reasonable option is weighed and turned down, not because the reasoning is wrong but because it leads nowhere; the refusal states what must hold from now on.
patterns.note: Kept at this rank by a floor rule: the domain count is below the bar, and ranks are not computed downward.

patterns.name: Checkable at a glance
patterns.stands_for: A claim is made; it is laid out so anyone can check it at a glance; the checking is built into the form, not left as a separate step.

patterns.name: Own it instead
patterns.stands_for: A black box or outside dependency is spotted; it is turned down; an alternative under one's own control is stated or built.
patterns.note: Kept at this rank by a floor rule: the domain count is below the bar, and ranks are not computed downward.

patterns.name: Naming the lens
patterns.stands_for: Input triggers recognition; the person names which experience or expertise woke up; that naming is itself the record.
patterns.note: Kept at this rank by a floor rule: the domain count is below the bar, and ranks are not computed downward.

patterns.name: Skill never called on
patterns.stands_for: Expertise exists inside an organisation; it is never put to work on outcomes; the organisation does not know what it has.
patterns.note: Kept at this rank by a floor rule: the domain count is below the bar, and ranks are not computed downward.

patterns.name: Fix that never travels
patterns.stands_for: A correction exists but never spreads; the error lasts because the fix lacks reach, threatens a business, or costs more to spread than to ignore.
patterns.note: Kept at this rank by a floor rule: the domain count is below the bar, and ranks are not computed downward.

patterns.name: Safe wrapper, same rent
patterns.stands_for: An incumbent sees a disruption that threatens its income; it wraps the new capability in a safe-looking package; it keeps collecting under a new name.
patterns.note: Kept at this rank by a floor rule: the domain count is below the bar, and ranks are not computed downward.

patterns.name: Judgment labeled as judgment
patterns.stands_for: An output involves judgment; it is labeled as judgment to interpret rather than fact to act on; the line is visible in the output, not hidden in the maker's head.
patterns.note: Kept at this rank by a floor rule: the domain count is below the bar, and ranks are not computed downward.

patterns.name: Hidden editing
patterns.stands_for: Something selects, ranks, suppresses or rewrites while presenting itself as a plain pass-through; the choice is invisible to the reader.
patterns.note: Kept at this rank by a floor rule: the domain count is below the bar, and ranks are not computed downward.

patterns.name: Patterns spread by exposure
patterns.stands_for: Patterns spread through exposure rather than direct instruction; shapes are learned by being around them.

patterns.name: Same work, other room
patterns.stands_for: Same quality, same performance; a different room or audience; recognition and value change while the work does not.
patterns.note: Kept at this rank by a floor rule: the domain count is below the bar, and ranks are not computed downward.

patterns.name: Intent as the anchor
patterns.stands_for: The intent and purpose behind a change is held onto as the thing that stays one's own; not yet separated from other patterns.
patterns.note: Stated rank is not backed by verified captures (none); not lowered, the call is held for Dennis.

patterns.name: Set in its own success
patterns.stands_for: A mechanism that works stops adjusting; the stopping reads as success but reduces the ability to adapt.

patterns.name: Muscle lost to outsourcing
patterns.stands_for: A hard problem is handed to AI; the task gets done; the muscle that would have built the skill wastes away unseen.

patterns.name: Seen but not built
patterns.stands_for: A pattern is recognized and named, but nothing is built to act on it; recognition becomes a loop instead of a lever.
patterns.note: Held at candidate by Dennis's signed decision of 2026-07-26; four captures would compute a higher rank, but promotion is his call, not automatic.

original.source: The Diary of a CEO interview, Rick Rubin with Steven Bartlett (speaker attribution read from content; the transcript carries no labels)
original.line: AI doesn't have a point of view AI is the collected ideas that already exist

later.source: Naval podcast, How to Get Rich (without getting lucky), Naval Ravikant with Nivi
later.line: And very often the principal will sell you and convince you to work with a firm, but then all the work will be done by an agent who simply doesn't care as much and you can end up getting substandard service.

sample.what_comes_back: In both lines the thing in front (an AI that seems to think for itself, a firm that sells you in person) is not what makes the result; something underneath does (ideas that already exist, an agent who does not care as much).
